{{Quotation|game|Earned in [[Dungeons|dungeons]]. Spent in [[Lion's Arch]] to purchase rare and exotic gear, runes and sigils, crafting materials, and the legendary crafting components used in creating [[legendary weapon]]s.}} [[Has game icon::File:Tale of Dungeon Delving.png|24px]] [[Tale of Dungeon Delving|Tales of Dungeon Delving]] are a [[currency]] earned by completing [[dungeon]]s in [[explorable mode]]. They are stored in the [[Currency|Account Wallet]] and may be traded to any [[Dungeon Merchant]]. == Acquisition == === Overview === * Completing dungeon [[explorable mode]] paths: ** Each completion rewards 20 ** Bonus for first completion per path per day rewards 80 ** Completing 8 unique paths gives 150 (through {{item icon|Chest of Dungeoneering}} from {{achievement icon|page=Dungeon Frequenter}}) * Completing a dungeon [[Reward Track]] (such as [[Tyrian Dungeon Explorer Track]]) gives a total of 240 (through four respective '' Token Loot Boxes'') * Completing all {{achievement icon|Dungeon Rush (achievements)}} achievements during the [[Dungeon Rush]] [[special event]] gives a total of 770 === Contained in === * The {{item icon|Tyrian Exchange Voucher}} has a choice of {{item icon|300 Tales of Dungeon Delving}}. {{Contained in}} == Currency for == * See the [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons]] vendor page, and associated vendor subpages below. Vendors in other locations (see [[Dungeon Merchant#List of dungeon merchants|here]]) have identical inventories and pricing. ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/Ascalonian Catacombs|/Ascalonian Catacombs]] ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/Caudecus's Manor|/Caudecus's Manor]] ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/Twilight Arbor|/Twilight Arbor]] ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/Sorrow's Embrace|/Sorrow's Embrace]] ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/Citadel of Flame|/Citadel of Flame]] ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/Honor of the Waves|/Honor of the Waves]] ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/Crucible of Eternity|/Crucible of Eternity]] ** [[Dungeon Armor and Weapons/The Ruined City of Arah|/The Ruined City of Arah]] == Notes == * This currency was added on the [[Game updates/2022-06-07|June 7th, 2022]] game update and replaced every dungeon currency that existed prior to its release: ** {{token|Ascalonian Tear}} [[Ascalonian Tear]] ** {{token|Seal of Beetletun}} [[Seal of Beetletun]] ** {{token|Deadly Bloom}} [[Deadly Bloom]] ** {{token|se}} [[Manifesto of the Moletariate]] ** {{token|Flame Legion Charr Carving}} [[Flame Legion Charr Carving]] ** {{token|Symbol of Koda}} [[Symbol of Koda]] ** {{token|Knowledge Crystal}} [[Knowledge Crystal]] ** {{token|Shard of Zhaitan}} [[Shard of Zhaitan]] * Upon logging in after the update was installed, players received this message in their mail: {{Mail | sender = [[Tyrian Explorers Society]] | subject = Your dungeon tokens have been converted! | content = Dear Explorer,

Tales of your deeds have travelled far and wide! However, these tales change with each retelling. To alleviate this, the Tyrian Explorers Society has adopted a new system. All tokens you received are now converted into Tales of Dungeon Delving. Rest assured, these Tales can be exchanged at the same rate as previous tokens at a local dungeon vendor. However, because this system has been unified, you may find yourself needing to re-explore these dungeons to access some of the goods these vendors possess.

Happy Delving! | sign = Tyrian Explorers Society }} {{Currencies nav}} [[de:Anekdote der Verlieserkundung]] [[es:Relato de exploración de mazmorra]] [[fr:Haut fait d'exploration de donjon]]
title: Tale of Dungeon Delving
